gloss: to be associated with; to derive from

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: ちなんでいませんでした

definitions.gloss: to be associated with, to be named after, to derive from
definitions.explanation: To have a connection or origin related to something. Most commonly encountered in the form ちなんで (named after) or the set phrase ちなみに (incidentally, by the way).

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{伝説|でんせつ}→伝説：11446_densetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ちなんで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This festival is based on an old legend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ちなんだ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}けた→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I gave a name associated with cherry blossoms.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいた→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ちなんで{名|な}づけられた。
examples.english: This street was named after a famous writer who once lived here.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ちなんで: named after ~, associated with ~
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ちなんだ + noun: ~ associated with, ~ named after

RELATED: The common adverb ちなみ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (by the way, incidentally) derives from this verb. It is used to add supplementary or related information to a conversation.

USAGE: Rarely used in its plain dictionary form. Almost always appears as ちなんで, ちなんだ, or in the adverbial form ちなみ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.
